learningObjective: Identify the trade-offs of INT4 KV cache quantization vs INT8/FP8 for LLM serving.

canonicalClaims.claim: INT4 KV cache halves KV memory footprint again vs INT8 (4× vs FP16) but is more accuracy-sensitive at long contexts because coarser per-element quantization amplifies softmax's cumulative logit noise; kernel-side support is less mature than INT8/FP8, with many stacks dequantizing INT4 KVs to FP16 in the attention kernel.
conditions: Per-token or per-head-per-token scaling for KV quantization.
The attention kernel supports the chosen quantized dtype at least via dequant-in-register.
nonImplications: Does not imply INT4 KV is unusable — many workloads tolerate the accuracy trade-off.
Does not imply INT4 KV yields 2× speedup over INT8; kernel overhead reduces the effective gain.

misconceptions.claim: INT4 KV cache is always at least as accurate as INT8 KV cache because more scale factors are stored.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Per-element precision (4 vs 8 bits) is the dominant factor; scale-factor count cannot compensate for 4-bit resolution.

misconceptions.claim: INT4 KV cache requires FP4 Tensor Cores on the deployment GPU.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Attention kernels typically dequant INT4 KVs to FP16 in registers; FP4 Tensor Cores are not required (and were not available in the referenced framework versions).

misconceptions.claim: INT4 KV cache is universally supported across attention kernels and delivers speedup identical to INT8.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Kernel support is less mature than INT8/FP8; effective speedup depends on dequant path and kernel maturity.

misconceptions.claim: Accuracy at INT4 KV is independent of context length.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Softmax cumulatively amplifies logit noise; longer contexts see larger accuracy drops from KV quantization noise.
misconceptions.sourceOrEvidence: KV quantization ablations across context lengths

implementationFacts: TensorRT-LLM: INT4 KV supported experimentally in recent versions.
vLLM: FP8 and INT8 KV cache are production-ready; INT4 KV is less common.
performanceScenarios: LLaMA-70B at 8K context: INT4 KV shows 1-3% accuracy drop on long-context QA vs INT8 KV, but doubles the concurrent-request capacity.
